risks.risk: Transmission may not shift through all gears or may have internal failure.
risks.proof: Video of the unit shifting through all gears on a test bench or installed in a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional or unknown operation.

risks.risk: Transmission may be leaking fluid (dark stains on ground in Photo 2).
risks.proof: Close-up video of the pan, seals, and bell housing for leaks, or a pressure/leak test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as leaking and needing reseal.

risks.risk: Internal components such as solenoids or valve body may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Video or photos showing the valve body and solenoids installed, or an internal inspection.

risks.risk: Mileage and usage history unknown; may be high-mileage or worn.
risks.proof: Service records or a verifiable history; otherwise an internal wear inspection video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown or high mileage.

risks.risk: May not be compatible with the buyer's specific vehicle make, model, or year.
risks.proof: VIN match or compatibility documentation showing fitment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fitment unknown; buyer assumes compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Torque converter may be mismatched or damaged (shown separate in Photo 0).
risks.proof: Video showing the torque converter matches the transmission and rotates freely without damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as torque converter condition unknown.

risks.risk: Transmission fluid may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of fluid container included with the sale.
Screenshot or document of warranty terms.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sold as-is with no warranty.

proof_requests: Video of the transmission shifting through all gears.
Close-up video of seals and pan to confirm no leaks.
